verdict.rationale: The axis applies because the GPU ships with a first-party software stack (the CUDA Toolkit and SDKs) whose APIs could be versioned with a deprecation policy. The evidence only names a release ('CUDA 13.4') and documents no API versioning scheme or deprecation policy, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
